cmd.openPreviewToSide: Open Pretty Preview to the Side
cmd.toggleOpenByDefault: Toggle Opening Markdown Files in pretty.md by Default
config.theme: Reading theme of the pretty.md preview. You can also switch it from the palette button in the preview toolbar.
config.fontSize: Base text size in pixels (the toolbar's A / A buttons change it too).
config.editSourceBeside: Open the Markdown source in a split editor next to the preview (the preview updates live while you type). When off, the source replaces the preview in the same editor group.
config.scrollSync: Scroll the preview along when you scroll the Markdown source.
config.typographer: Typographic niceties: curly quotes, en/em dashes (`--`, `---`), ellipses.
config.breaks:
